properties.name: Octavia E. Butler Landing
properties.description: Historic touchdown site of the Mars 2020 Perseverance rover and Ingenuity helicopter in western Isidis Planitia.
properties.geology: Volcanic/impact floor unit, mafic olivine-rich sand and bedrock regolith.
properties.image_caption: First high-resolution color view from Perseverance landing site

properties.name: Western Delta Scarp (Three Forks)
properties.description: Ancient river delta front where Jezero's river entered the crater lake ~3.7 billion years ago, preserving fine-grained biosignature targets.
properties.geology: Layered smectite clays, carbonate minerals, and silica siltstones with high biosignature preservation potential.
properties.image_caption: Perseverance Mastcam-Z mosaic of the Western Delta scarp

properties.name: Kodiak Butte
properties.description: Isolated mesa remnant of the delta proving lake depth and multi-stage flooding in Jezero's ancient lacustrine system.
properties.geology: Steep-dipping delta foreset beds overlain by horizontal topset conglomerate layers with rounded boulders.
properties.image_caption: SuperCam long-distance view of Kodiak mesa cross-bedding

properties.name: Belva Impact Crater
properties.description: Large ~1 km wide impact crater penetrating the delta deposit, excavating pre-existing crater floor strata and hydrothermal rocks.
properties.geology: Hydrothermally altered megabreccia, tilted fault blocks, and deep-seated Isidis basin crustal units.
properties.image_caption: Mastcam-Z 360-degree panorama from Belva crater rim

properties.name: Neretva Vallis Inlet
properties.description: The deep fluvial channel carved through the western rim of Jezero Crater by catastrophic torrents sourcing materials from hundreds of kilometers away.
properties.geology: Conglomerates with exotic volcanic clasts, quartz-bearing igneous rocks, and noachian basement terranes.
properties.image_caption: Neretva Vallis canyon breach looking upstream into Noachian highlands

properties.name: MSR Sample #2: Montdenier Core (ST20-003)
properties.description: Official NASA Mars Sample Return core tube #2. First igneous core successfully cached by Perseverance. Deposited at the Three Forks off-world depot on Sol 653 for recovery by the Sample Retrieval Lander.
properties.geology: Vesicular pyroxene-plagioclase basalt with secondary carbonate and sulfate mineral coatings.
properties.image_caption: Montdenier rock core inside Perseverance sample tube #003

properties.name: MSR Sample #7: Malay Delta Mudstone (ST20-008)
properties.description: Official NASA Mars Sample Return core tube #7. Fine-grained delta mudstone rich in phyllosilicate smectite clays with exceptional biosignature preservation potential. Secured inside the Rover Belly Cache.
properties.geology: Fine-grained smectite clay mudstone preserving high organic carbon concentrations (SHERLOC / SuperCam).
properties.depot_status: Secured in Onboard Rover Belly Cache
properties.image_caption: Malay delta front rock core inside Perseverance sample tube #008

properties.name: MSR Sample #13: Bearwallow Delta Top (ST20-014)
properties.description: Official NASA Mars Sample Return core tube #13. Coarse-grained sandstone from the delta top fluvial flood deposits, deposited at the Three Forks Depot on Sol 680.
properties.geology: Feldspathic lithic sandstone with cross-bedding and iron-magnesium phyllosilicates.
